previous_last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now keeps the embedded INI drive's USB block size independent of the SD driver, while SD-card USB buffers are sized from the SD driver's own block size. The existing USB Mass Storage page is updated to describe this split and to pin its source references to the new revision. No tune, calibration, or TunerStudio setting changes are required.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU separated the USB block sizing of the embedded INI drive from the SD driver. The INI drive keeps a fixed 512-byte block size whether or not SD support is compiled in, and the SD-card USB buffer is now sized from the SD driver's block size instead of a shared constant. This matters for builders of INI-only mass-storage firmware and for boards whose SD driver uses a different block size; no TunerStudio setting or tune migration is involved. The existing USB Mass Storage page is updated to describe the split and to pin its source links to this revision.

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU adds SD-card file logging as a first-class build module. It is included by default on supported boards, can be disabled on non-Atlas boards, and is required on Atlas. SD logging is now independent of USB mass storage and the embedded TunerStudio INI drive. The web build catalog gains a dedicated sd_card boolean input and per-board required-module metadata, and the resource calibration and packaging tools account for board-required modules. Builders must stop setting USE_FATFS directly and must include sd_card in explicit FOME_MODULES profiles where card logging is wanted.

decisions.rationale: SD-card file logging becomes a build module named sd_card. It is in the default profile, Atlas requires it, and the main firmware Makefile now derives USE_FATFS and EFI_FILE_LOGGING from the resolved module list. Builders who set USE_FATFS explicitly must remove it, because a conflicting value now fails configuration. Explicit FOME_MODULES profiles must include sd_card to keep card logging. USB mass storage and the embedded INI drive are now independent of SD logging. The TunerStudio SD Card Logger menu, indicators, and SD CS pin field appear only when the module is built.
evidence: firmware/Makefile: USE_FATFS is derived from FOME_MODULES_RESOLVED and a conflicting explicit USE_FATFS raises an error; DDEFS adds -DEFI_FILE_LOGGING from the sd_card selection

firmware/hw_layer/ports/stm32/stm32f4/efifeatures.h: EFI_USB_MSD default changed from EFI_FILE_LOGGING to TRUE
firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini: SD Card Logger menu, indicators, and fields gated by @@if_FOME_SD_CARD_ENABLED

decisions.rationale: Reduced boards keep their previous exclusions. nucleo_f767 and small-can-board declare sd_card unsupported and keep EFI_FILE_LOGGING and EFI_USB_MSD disabled. The main firmware Makefile now strips board-level EFI_FILE_LOGGING definitions before applying the module-derived value, so the module profile controls file logging in the application while the bootloader keeps its own board value. Builders of these boards cannot enable sd_card through FOME_MODULES.
evidence: firmware/Makefile: DDEFS := $(filter-out -DEFI_FILE_LOGGING=%,$(DDEFS)) before adding the module-derived EFI_FILE_LOGGING

decisions.rationale: The web custom-firmware build gains a dedicated sd_card boolean input, default true, separate from the features list. The resolver rejects sd_card=false combined with sd_card in features, rejects disabling a board-required module such as Atlas sd_card, and reports required_modules per board. The resource calibration plan now treats board-required modules as part of the mandatory baseline and emits sd_card separately from features. Builders using the catalog or calibration tools should pass --sd-card and read required_modules to lock required selections.
evidence: .github/workflows/custom-firmware-build.yaml: new sd_card boolean input default true, forwarded as --sd-card

misc/firmware_builder/calibration.py: _required_modules, _board_modules, and sd_card-aware profile specs and records
docs/build-modules.md and docs/build-resources.md updated with sd_card selection and board-required baseline behavior

decisions.rationale: Packaged firmware manifests now record the requested sd_card selection separately from the normalized features string and preserve resolved required_modules. The documentation clarifies that sd_card is default-on only on supported boards and that nucleo_f767 and small-can-board declare it unsupported. Consumers of the manifest should read requested.sd_card and resolved.required_modules rather than inferring SD logging from the features field.

firmware/CHANGELOG.md: sd_card entry reworded to included by default in firmware and web builds
